criteria.criterion: Both conditional moments and the estimator are correctly normalized.
Explains the support/observability role and failure at zero probability.
Explains why the actual sampling law must match the denominator.
Explains predictability using action-dependent loss failure; does not demand independent rounds.
Separates one-round moments from a regret guarantee.

pass_rule: All criteria score 2 for the reference-control pass. Report each axis separately, never a combined capability score.
acceptable_alternatives: Equivalent notation and finite-sum order are accepted.
Any correct derivation or fully verified counterexample satisfying the question is accepted.
For Lean, any proof of the unchanged target with permitted dependencies and axiom closure is accepted; no reference text matching.
common_errors: The mean is l_i/p_i and the second moment is l_i^2. Positive support only avoids a software error. Independent rounds are required, and these identities prove logarithmic regret.
assessment: Independent rubric review required. The local verifier validates review bindings and arithmetic, not mathematical meaning. No calibrated automatic judge is available.
